description.en: The risks that you want to detect by using the rule.

The cluster ID.

> This parameter is deprecated.

The cluster name.

> This parameter is deprecated.

description.zh:
该策略是否支持互联网恶意镜像。取值：

- **true**：支持
- **false**：不支持
description.en:
Specifies whether the rule supports malicious Internet images. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

description.zh:
策略命中时执行操作。取值：

- **1**：告警
- **2**：拦截
- **3**：放行
description.en:
The action that is performed when the rule is hit. Valid values:

- **1**: trigger alerts

- **2**: block

- **3**: allow
The application scope of the rule.

description.zh:
集群内策略实例ID。

><notice>创建时无需此参数。></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the cluster node to which the rule is applied.

> This parameter is not required when you create the instance.

description.zh:
是否包含所有命名空间。取值：

- **1**：是
- **0**：否
description.en:
Specifies whether to include all namespaces. Valid values:

- **1**: includes all namespaces.

- **0**: does not include all namespaces.

description.zh:
策略包含的集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~421736~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster that is specified in the rule.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~421736~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh:
命名空间列表。

><notice>本参数只有当AllNamespace为0时有效。></notice>
description.en:
The namespaces.

> This parameter is valid only when the AllNamespace parameter is set to 0.

description.zh:
策略ID。
>调用[ListOpaClusterStrategyNew](~~2623574~~)接口可以获取该参数。

<notice>创建策略时此参数无效。></notice>
description.en:
The rule ID.

> You can call the [ListOpaClusterStrategyNew](~~2623574~~) operation to query the rule ID.

> This parameter is invalid when you create a rule.

description.zh:
策略模板ID。
>调用[GetOpaStrategyTemplateSummary](~~2539952~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the rule template.

> You can call the [GetOpaStrategyTemplateSummary](~~2539952~~) operation to query the ID of the rule template.

description.zh:
该策略是否支持未扫描镜像。取值：

- **true**：支持
- **false**：不支持
description.en:
Specifies whether the rule supports unscanned images. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**
